fact: The Ministry of Education published its annual Boletim Estatístico 2019/2020 in February 2021, compiled from school records supplied by public and private schools at the start and end of each school year.
title: Boletim Estatístico 2019/2020
publisher: Ministério da Educação e Ensino Superior, Direcção de Planeamento e Inovação Educativa
